import pandas as pd
from datetime import date

pd.set_option("display.width", 250)
pd.set_option("display.max_colwidth", 92)
pd.set_option("display.max_rows", 300)

TODAY = date(2026,10,12)
DOL   = date(2024,11,15)
EFF   = date(2024,1,1)
EXP   = date(2024,12,31)
DOL_TO_INTAKE = (TODAY-DOL).days
DAYS_TO_EXPIRY_AT_DOL = (EXP-DOL).days
DAYS_INTO_TERM = (DOL-EFF).days

UNK = "INSUFFICIENT DATA - cannot assess"

# ---------------- A. FRAUD / SIU SIGNAL SCREEN ----------------
# signal_level: PRESENT (observable from given facts), PARTIAL, INSUFFICIENT
A = [
 ("Late reporting / delay in notice to carrier",
  "PARTIAL",
  f"Loss {DOL} vs. intake {TODAY} = {DOL_TO_INTAKE} days. BUT the FNOL date to the carrier is NOT supplied - cannot assume the carrier was unaware. Only DOL-to-intake is known.",
  "Actual FNOL date and method (EV-05); any earlier correspondence (EV-08)"),
 ("Loss close to policy expiration",
  "PARTIAL - SOFT",
  f"Loss fell {DAYS_TO_EXPIRY_AT_DOL} days before expiry ({EXP}). Near-expiry losses are a standard review trigger; near-expiry is a weaker indicator than near-inception.",
  "Prior loss history and renewal negotiation notes (EV-30)"),
 ("Loss near policy inception / reinstatement",
  "NOT PRESENT",
  f"Loss was {DAYS_INTO_TERM} days into the term - not a near-inception loss.",
  "-"),
 ("Nature of loss inherently suspicious",
  "NOT PRESENT (as stated)",
  "A burst pipe is a common, ordinary peril. No inherently implausible mechanism described.",
  "-"),
 ("Damage inconsistent with described cause",
  "CANNOT ASSESS YET",
  "Flooring + drywall + inventory are all plausible for a back-room pipe burst, but the geography (is inventory stored in the back room? is flooring exposed there?) is not stated.",
  "Site photos (EV-14), moisture map (EV-15), scope of work (EV-18), floor plan"),
 ("Absence of mold after prolonged water exposure",
  "PARTIAL - UNEXPLAINED",
  "If water truly sat for ~23 months, mold/wet rot would ordinarily be expected. No mold is reported. This is an internal-consistency question, not proof of anything.",
  "Mitigation timeline (EV-23/24); whether remediation occurred; mold lab results (EV-25)"),
 ("Financial distress of the insured",
  UNK, "No financial information supplied.", "Financials (EV-36); credit / bankruptcy search"),
 ("Prior similar losses at this location",
  UNK, "No loss history supplied.", "Loss runs for the location (EV-30)"),
 ("Inconsistency in the insured's own accounts",
  UNK, "No statements or interviews obtained.", "Recorded statement (EV-42)"),
 ("Over-valuation / unsupported values for damaged property",
  UNK, "Inventory and flooring values not yet produced.", "Stock inventory + invoices (EV-19/20)"),
 ("Claim for items unlikely to be damaged by this cause",
  UNK, "The inventory items and their storage location are not stated.", "Inventory list with locations (EV-19)"),
 ("Failure/refusal to provide records",
  UNK, "No document requests have yet been made or refused.", "Document production log"),
 ("Occupancy inconsistent with reported loss",
  UNK, "Occupancy status at DOL not supplied.", "POS / staff / utility records (EV-32/33/34)"),
 ("Claimant pressure for rapid settlement / unsupported urgency",
  UNK, "No communications from the claimant supplied.", "Correspondence file (EV-08)"),
 ("Involvement of a public adjuster or unusually early legal representation",
  UNK, "Not stated.", "Claim file / assignments (EV-06)"),
 ("Existence of a pre-loss sale, closure, or business transition",
  UNK, "Not stated.", "Financials, lease status (EV-36/37)"),
 ("Multiple policies / duplicate claim for same loss",
  UNK, "Only one policy referenced; no duplicate identified.", "Loss runs; other carriers"),
 ("Physical evidence of intentional damage or staging",
  UNK, "No inspection has occurred.", "Cause & origin report (EV-09/10); preserved pipe (EV-12)"),
]

A_cols = ["Fraud / SIU indicator","Signal level","Basis (limited to facts provided)","What is needed to resolve"]
A_df = pd.DataFrame(A, columns=A_cols)

# ---------------- B. DAMAGE SIGNAL CONSISTENCY ----------------
B = [
 ("Flooring - water damage to flooring","Consistent with cause",
  "Escape of water onto a floor is a direct, expected consequence of a burst pipe.","Moisture map + flooring material (EV-15/18) to confirm extent vs. replacement of entire floor.",
  "Scope may include undamaged areas if entire floor replaced - allocation question."),
 ("Drywall - water damage to drywall","Consistent with cause",
  "Water migration into wall cavities and wicking up drywall is expected.","Photo evidence + moisture readings at wall height (EV-14/15).",
  "Wicking height should correlate with volume and duration; check 'flood cut' height."),
 ("Inventory - water damage to stock","Consistent only if geographically plausible",
  "Inventory is only directly damaged if stored in or adjacent to the affected back room.","Inventory list with storage location + aisle/rack (EV-19); floor plan.",
  "If stock is stored elsewhere (front of store), direct water damage is questionable - needs explanation."),
 ("Multiple building systems / widespread scope","Watch item",
  "Three separate property classes (floor, wall, contents) can all be expected from one event, but the combined scope should be proportionate to a single-room pipe burst.","Itemized scope + photos (EV-17/18/14).",
  "Oversized scope relative to a 'back room' origin would be a review trigger."),
 ("Reported speed / duration of exposure","Unknown - critical",
  "The description says 'burst' (sudden). The 23-month reporting gap raises the question of whether water actually flowed undetected for an extended period.","Mitigation date stamp; drying logs; cause & origin (EV-23/24/09).",
  "Sudden burst vs. prolonged escape changes which exclusion applies - this is the pivotal damage signal."),
 ("Causation timeline","Unknown",
  "No date-stamped evidence ties the damage to 2024-11-15 rather than a later or earlier period.","Date-stamped photos, plumber report, POS records (EV-14/09/32).",
  "Damage dating must be corroborated independently of the insured's account."),
 ("Repair vs. replace approach","Unknown",
  "Whether damaged items are being repaired or replaced drives RCV/ACV and salvage.","Contractor estimates + valuation basis (EV-17/20).",
  "Consider salvage/subrogation offsets on replaced inventory."),
]
B_cols = ["Reported damage element","Consistent with stated cause?","Basis","Corroboration required","Review note"]
B_df = pd.DataFrame(B, columns=B_cols)

# ---------------- C. SUBROGATION OPPORTUNITIES ----------------
C = [
 ("Defective plumbing repair / workmanship",
  "Negligence / breach of contract or warranty",
  "Third-party contractor or plumber whose work caused or contributed to the rupture.",
  "Work order, invoice, contract, cause & origin attribution to the repair (EV-29, EV-40, EV-09).",
  "CONDITIONAL - no repair is known to have occurred; cannot assume one.",
  "No third party identified yet; 22-month delay may have replaced the failed section."),
 ("Landlord / premises owner",
  "Landlord's contractual duty to maintain, or negligence",
  "If the claimant is a tenant and the failed pipe is landlord-maintained.",
  "Lease agreement allocating maintenance; ownership records (EV-37).",
  "UNKNOWN - ownership vs. leasehold not supplied; cannot assume either.",
  "Only arises if claimant is not the sole owner-occupant."),
 ("Manufacturer / supplier of the pipe or fitting",
  "Product liability (WA Product Liability Act, RCW 7.72)",
  "Defect in manufacture or design of the failed component.",
  "Preserved failed section for metallurgical/failure analysis (EV-12).",
  "WEAK AS STATED - no product defect asserted and no artifact preserved.",
  "Artifact almost certainly lost after 22 months; statute of repose and spoliation both cut against this."),
 ("Adjoining tenant or third-party utility",
  "Negligence",
  "Third party caused the pipe to fail or water from elsewhere entered.",
  "Evidence of third-party activity; camera/borescope inspection (EV-11).",
  "SPECULATIVE - no fact supplied points to a third party.",
  "Do not pursue without evidence."),
 ("Weather/freeze causation",
  "No subrogation target",
  "A freeze is an Act of God and creates no liable party.",
  "N/A.",
  "N/A",
  "If freeze is established, it removes subrogation but also raises the freeze exclusion against coverage."),
 ("Insured's own conduct (overpressure, neglect, failure to heat)",
  "Not subrogation - coverage defense",
  "Insured's own act/omission.",
  "Occupancy + heating records (EV-32/33).",
  "N/A",
  "This is a coverage issue, not a recovery."),
]
C_cols = ["Subrogation theory","Legal basis","Target party","Evidence required","Current viability","Blocker / caveat"]
C_df = pd.DataFrame(C, columns=C_cols)

# ---------------- D. LIMITATION CLOCKS CONSUMED BY THE DELAY ----------------
D = [
 ("Carrier subrogation - negligence (general)","3 years from date of loss","RCW 4.16.080(2)",
  str(DOL), str(date(2027,11,15)), (date(2027,11,15)-TODAY).days, "OPEN - but eroding"),
 ("Carrier subrogation - written contract / warranty","6 years from breach","RCW 4.16.040",
  str(DOL), str(date(2030,11,15)), (date(2030,11,15)-TODAY).days, "OPEN"),
 ("Product liability (WA PLA)","3 years from discovery of harm & cause; 12-year repose","RCW 7.72.060",
  "Not established", "-", None, "WEAK - artifact not preserved"),
 ("Insured vs. carrier - suit-limitation clause","Per policy (commonly 1-3 yrs from DOL)","Policy condition (contract)",
  str(DOL), "Per policy wording", None, "UNKNOWN - clause not supplied; may already bar the claim"),
 ("Carrier response to insured (WA)","Acknowledge 10 working days / affirm-deny 15 working days of a complete POCL","WAC 284-30-380",
  "POCL not received", "-", None, "NOT YET RUNNING"),
]
D_cols = ["Clock","Period","Authority","Start date","Earliest expiry","Days remaining","Status"]
D_df = pd.DataFrame(D, columns=D_cols)

# ---------------- E. SIGNAL ROLL-UP ----------------
roll = pd.Series({
 "Fraud indicators PRESENT or PARTIAL": (A_df["Signal level"].str.contains("PRESENT|PARTIAL")).sum(),
 "Fraud indicators INSUFFICIENT DATA": (A_df["Signal level"]==UNK).sum(),
 "Fraud indicators expressly NOT PRESENT": (A_df["Signal level"].str.contains("NOT PRESENT")).sum(),
 "Subrogation theories - CONDITIONAL/WEAK/SPECULATIVE (none confirmed)": (C_df["Current viability"].str.contains("CONDITIONAL|WEAK|SPECULATIVE")).sum(),
 "Subrogation theories - actionable now": 0,
})

print("="*150)
print(f"LIABILITY & DAMAGE SIGNAL INVESTIGATION | Policy CP-2024-1187 | Harborview Retail LLC | DOL {DOL} | Prepared {TODAY}")
print(f"Key timing: DOL->intake {DOL_TO_INTAKE} days (~{DOL_TO_INTAKE/365.25:.1f} yrs) | DOL was {DAYS_TO_EXPIRY_AT_DOL} days before policy expiry")
print("Scope note: assessment is limited strictly to facts supplied. Nothing is assumed beyond them.")
print("="*150)

print("\n--- E. SIGNAL ROLL-UP ---")
print(roll.to_string())

print("\n--- A. FRAUD / SIU INDICATOR SCREEN (limited to known facts) ---")
print(A_df.to_string(index=False))

print("\n--- B. DAMAGE SIGNAL CONSISTENCY CHECK ---")
print(B_df.to_string(index=False))

print("\n--- C. SUBROGATION OPPORTUNITY MATRIX ---")
print(C_df.to_string(index=False))

print("\n--- D. LIMITATION CLOCKS ---")
print(D_df.to_string(index=False))
